discovery.problem: Exponer una interfaz pública (Landing Page) con autenticación para que solo usuarios registrados puedan lanzar escaneos de seguridad WASA, sin acceso directo a n8n.
discovery.system_type: saas_multi_tenant (sin aislamiento de tenant real; ver scale)
discovery.stack: React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind + Zustand (frontend) / Python 3.11 + FastAPI + Pydantic v2 + SQLAlchemy async (asyncpg) + python-jose + passlib (backend) / PostgreSQL db_fuzzing (compartida) + n8n + Redis (infra existente)

recommended.name: vercel-react-best-practices
recommended.why: Official Vercel React/Next-adjacent best practices; directly matches the React 18 + Vite + TS frontend.

recommended.name: tailwind-design-system
recommended.why: High-install Tailwind design-system conventions for the landing page UI; alternative: giuseppe-trisciuoglio/developer-kit@tailwind-css-patterns (15.2K).

recommended.name: zustand-state-management
recommended.why: Dedicated Zustand patterns skill matching the frontend's state manager; broader alternative: wshobson/agents@react-state-management (12.9K).

recommended.name: react-hook-form-zod
recommended.why: Exact-combo skill for React Hook Form + Zod, used for the landing page's signup/login/scan-request forms.

recommended.name: zod-validation-utilities
recommended.why: Deeper Zod schema-validation reference for request/response contracts shared with the FastAPI bridge.

recommended.name: fastapi-templates
recommended.why: Highest-install FastAPI skill; scaffolds routers/dependencies matching the bridge's Pydantic v2 + async SQLAlchemy stack.

recommended.name: fastapi (official)
recommended.why: Official FastAPI org skill — lower installs but most authoritative source for framework-specific guidance.

recommended.name: fastapi-async-patterns
recommended.why: Targets async FastAPI + asyncpg/SQLAlchemy patterns, matching the bridge's async DB access to the shared db_fuzzing instance.

recommended.name: sqlalchemy-alembic-expert-best-practices-code-review
recommended.why: SQLAlchemy + Alembic best-practice review, relevant for safely reading/writing the shared PostgreSQL scan tables without breaking existing schema.

recommended.name: pydantic (official)
recommended.why: Official Pydantic org skill; matches Pydantic v2 request/response models used by the bridge.

recommended.name: auth-security-reviewer
recommended.why: Reviews auth implementations specifically — directly applicable to the JWT auth wall gating access to WASA scans (CRITICAL-governance domain).

recommended.name: testing-api-authentication-weaknesses
recommended.why: Cybersecurity-focused skill for probing API auth weaknesses; aligns with the AppSec domain and JWT-gated endpoints.

recommended.name: api-authentication
recommended.why: General API authentication implementation guidance covering JWT flows used by python-jose/passlib in the bridge.

recommended.name: implementing-api-rate-limiting-and-throttling
recommended.why: Security-focused rate-limiting guidance matching the slowapi dependency, important to prevent scan-trigger abuse.

recommended.name: security-review
recommended.why: Reputable (Sentry) general security-review skill for the auth wall and bridge code; note a built-in `security-review` skill is already available natively in this environment and may cover part of this need without install.

recommended.name: application-security-testing
recommended.why: AppSec testing skill matching the project's cybersecurity/AppSec-tooling domain (orchestrating ZAP/Nuclei/ffuf/SQLMap via WASA).

recommended.name: appsec-owasp
recommended.why: OWASP-aligned AppSec checklist skill, useful for hardening the public landing page + auth bridge against common web vulnerabilities.

recommended.name: n8n-workflow
recommended.why: Highest-install n8n workflow skill; relevant since the bridge triggers WASA scans orchestrated via n8n without touching it directly.
